title: Entropy-Weighted Local Concept Matching for Robust Zero-Shot OOD Detection

contributions.purpose: 用信息论方法评估 patch 可靠性以修复 GL-MCM 的 max-pooling 缺陷
contributions.mechanism: 对每个空间 patch 算 ID 类概率分布并求 Shannon 熵 H_i,用指数衰减权重 w_i=exp(-alpha*H_i) 加权局部得分替代最大池化(增强版加 class-conditional scaling、top-16 选择、25 分位稳定)
contributions.evaluation: 推理开销 O(NK),<5% 时延增加,零训练零样本
contributions.domain: 视觉-语言零样本 OOD 检测
contributions.source_quote: We introduce Entropy-Weighted Local Concept Matching (ELCM), replacing heuristic max-pooling with information-theoretic aggregation.

contributions.purpose: 验证 ELCM 相对 GL-MCM 基线的检测提升
contributions.mechanism: 在 ImageNet-OOD(iNaturalist/SUN/places365/Texture)上对比 AUROC 与 FPR95
contributions.evaluation: 总 AUROC 0.913→0.919,FPR95 0.350→0.298(降14.9%);iNaturalist FPR95 降19%,SUN 降23%
contributions.source_quote: overall AUROC improves from 0.9129 to 0.9188, while FPR95 decreases 15% (0.3495 to 0.2975).

contributions.purpose: 揭示方法对熵权强度 alpha 的严重敏感性
contributions.mechanism: 在 iNaturalist 上扫 alpha=0.5/1.0/2.0 做消融
contributions.evaluation: alpha=0.5 时灾难性失败(AUROC 0.905<基线0.913,FPR95 0.429),需 alpha>=1.0 才可靠
contributions.source_quote: The catastrophic failure at alpha = 0.5 demonstrates that misconfiguration can worsen performance. The narrow range of effective alpha values limits plug-and-play applicability.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We present ELCM, which builds upon GL-MCM to address its vulnerability to spurious patch activations through entropy-based weighting.
We replace max-pooling with information-theoretic aggregation using Shannon entropy ... ELCM provides principled spatial aggregation that could benefit multiple zero-shot frameworks.

notes: trade-off/负结果:SUN 上 ELCM AUROC 0.915 反而低于 GL-MCM 0.931(表1 该格 GL-MCM 加粗),只是 FPR95 更好;alpha<1.0 灾难性失败(AUROC 0.905 vs 0.913)。作者自认基线覆盖不足(只比 GL-MCM,未比 CLIPN/ZOC/MCM),坦言'may overstate practical significance'。数据红旗:图1/图2 分数分布横轴仅 0.0016~0.0018 区间,标题却称'Confidence scores are negative due to the scoring formulation'(与图示正值矛盾);仅评 100 张图(消融 500)。摘要 0.9188 与表 1 的 0.919 属四舍五入一致。贡献由论文自声明的 Theoretical/Technical/Performance 三条归纳。
